mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT ar.`id` ) AS `alarm_num`, ar.`application_code` AS `type_code` FROM `alarm_record` ar
GROUP BY ar.`application_code`

SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT ar.`id` ) AS `alarm_num`, COALESCE ( SUM( IF ( `alarm_status` = 'ALARM_HANDLER', 1, 0 )), 0 ) AS `handler_num`, COALESCE ( SUM( IF ( `alarm_status` != 'ALARM_HANDLER', 1, 0 )), 0 ) AS `no_handler_num` FROM `alarm_record` ar

SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT ar.`id` ) AS `alarm_num`, ar.`alarm_level_code` AS `type_code`, ar.`alarm_level_name` AS `type_name` FROM `alarm_record` ar
GROUP BY ar.`alarm_level_code`, ar.`alarm_level_name` ORDER BY ar.`alarm_level_sort`

SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT ar.`id` ) AS `alarm_num`, ar.`alarm_event_type_code` AS `type_code`, ar.`alarm_event_type_name` AS `type_name` FROM `alarm_record` ar
GROUP BY ar.`alarm_event_type_code`, ar.`alarm_event_type_name`

SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT ar.`id` ) AS alarm_num, COALESCE (sum(if(`alarm_status` != 'ALARM_UN_CONFIRMED',1,0)),0) as `responded_num`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_status` = 'ALARM_HANDLER',1,0)),0) as `handler_num`, COALESCE (SUM( IF ( `alarm_status` != 'ALARM_HANDLER' AND `timeout_process_time` <= NOW() or `alarm_status` = 'ALARM_HANDLER' AND `timeout_process_time` <= `alarm_handler_time`, 1, 0 )), 0 ) AS `timeout_num` FROM `alarm_record` ar

SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT ar.`id` ) AS `alarm_num`, arhu.`user_id`, arhu.`user_name`, COALESCE (sum(if(`alarm_status` != 'ALARM_UN_CONFIRMED',1,0)),0) as `responded_num`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_status` = 'ALARM_HANDLER',1,0)),0) as `handler_num`, COALESCE (SUM( IF ( `alarm_status` != 'ALARM_HANDLER' AND `timeout_process_time` <= NOW() or `alarm_status` = 'ALARM_HANDLER' AND `timeout_process_time` <= `alarm_handler_time`, 1, 0 )), 0 ) AS `timeout_num` FROM `alarm_record` ar INNER JOIN `alarm_record_handler_user` arhu ON arhu.`alarm_record_id` = ar.`id`
GROUP BY arhu.`user_id`, arhu.`user_name`

SELECT ar.`alarm_event_type_name` AS `type_code`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_status` = 'ALARM_HANDLER',1,0)),0) as `handler_num`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_handler_result` = 'ALARM_ACTUAL',1,0)),0) as `alarm_actual_num` FROM `alarm_record` ar
GROUP BY ar.`alarm_event_type_name`
